messages:
Julia: Heads-up: Acme wants tenant-level prewarm SLA + HSM-backed key rotation. Needs launch gates before EPD next Wed. Can we align owners and scope?

Sam: Clarify prewarm SLA: reserved slots per tenant vs percent-of-cluster?

Julia: Reserved tenant slots. They expect p99 stability under spikes and HSM for key rotations (no plaintext on hosts).

Karim: Reserved slots => Dedicated pools or reservation in Hosted. Need mapping to GPU pools and billing. Pilot estimate: 4 reserved pods.

Megan: HSM requires KMS/HSM connector, rotation policy, and audit logs for unwrap events; impacts runtime sync path.

Tom: Avoid per-request HSM calls. Propose envelope-key flow: HSM wraps ephemeral keys; runtime caches envelope keys in RAM.

Sam: Agree. Plan: master-wrap key in HSM rotates (24h); runtime fetches wrapped ephemeral key, caches in memory; define fallback if HSM unavailable.

Megan: Fallback policy: max 15m, alert if HSM down >1m. Need threat-model signoff for in-memory caching (mlock, no core dumps).

Karim: Infra work: KMS connector (3d), network+certs (2d), staging perf support (2d). VPN peering adds ~1d.

Julia: Acceptance criteria for EPD packet: p99 <=250ms at 1k RPS, warm start <500ms, HSM rotation + fallback tested within 15m, unwrap/audit logs, rollback to non-reserved routing on failures.

Sam: Pilot constraint: model <=7B quantized. I'll run perf tests once connector is ready.

Megan: I'll draft runbook and threat model; security signoff needed before EPD.

Tom: Ops will own monitoring (HSM health, unwrap latency), alerts, and emergency key-roll runbook.

Julia: Owners: Product: Julia; Runtime: Sam; Infra: Karim; Security: Megan; SRE: Tom. Target EPD packet by Tue EOD. Feasible?

Sam: Tight but possible if infra hands connector Mon EOD. I'll reserve focused dev time Mon/Tue.

Karim: We'll prioritize connector; need certs/allowlist from security today; aiming Mon EOD. Updating infra estimate to 8d with VPN.

Megan: Sending cert checklist and minimal threat-model template now. Confirm Acme requires on-prem HSM with VPN peering?

Julia: Yes, on-prem appliance with VPN. They provide certs; we need network design.

Tom: Rollout gating: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with SLO checks; abort if unwrap latency >300ms or error rate >0.5%.

Sam: Add runtime knob to abort envelope refresh if unwrap latency spikes.

Julia: Action items: Karim: staging connector + VPN design doc by Mon EOD; Megan: runbook + cert checklist today; Sam: runtime PR Tue AM; Tom: dashboards+alerts Tue EOD; Julia: EPD draft Tue noon.

deploy-bot: Created ticket #INF-8421 "Acme reserved slots + HSM flow" assigned to karim; due 2026-03-02.

Julia: Aim to ship pilot with Acme in two weeks if no blockers. Flag issues here for escalation. :thumbsup:
